Welcome to tsdst's documentation!
=================================

This documentation covers the public functions, classes, and methods contained in the tsdst package. It is organized in alphabetical order, first by module name, and then by object name. Many of the methods discussed have general uses, however, most of the examples will be directly related to the reliability of mechanical systems. This document assumes a basic knowledge of Bayesian probability theory. For more info, see the following `Wikipedia article on Bayes Theorem`_.

.. _`Wikipedia article on Bayes Theorem` : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bayes%27_theorem

.. toctree::
   :maxdepth: 3
   :caption: Contents:

   API Pages  <api>
   Automatic EDA <eda>
   Weibull regression <weibull_regression>
